lines.text: Elders of Israel sit before Ezekiel, and the LORD says they have set up idols in their hearts.
The LORD will answer idolaters according to their great idolatry, to take hold of the hearts of Israel.
The Lord GOD tells the house of Israel to rejoice and turn away from their idols.
The LORD will set His face against the idol-hearted man and make him a sign and a leader.
The LORD will destroy the enticed prophet, so Israel stops straying and becomes His people, and He becomes their God.
